title: What Is Hubris? — Greek Myth Comix
skills: define hubris in literary and mythological contexts
identify excessive pride or arrogance in characters
analyze how hubris contributes to conflict and downfall
connect hubris to tragic structure and character development
alignment_note: Introduces hubris as excessive pride or arrogance, especially within Greek mythology and tragedy. Supports analysis of tragic heroes, character flaws, cause and consequence, and the role of pride in conflict and downfall across high school English courses.
